layout: - Phase 6 moved the casino screens into solitaireplus/games/casino/: blackjack_screen.py (BLACKJACK_BET + BLACKJACK screens, settle_blackjack_round, the blackjack drawing helpers; multi-screen module: loop_event_<screen>/loop_draw_<screen> names kept), roulette_screen.py (handle_event/draw, settle_roulette_round, try_place_or_remove_roulette_bet), horse_races_screen.py (handle_event/draw, settle_horse_race_result, the horse-race music cue), faro_screen.py (handle_event/draw). Game rules: games/casino/blackjack.py, roulette.py, horse_races.py, faro.py; UIs roulette_ui.py etc. Achievements: solitaireplus/profile/achievements.py. Career rating/fans helpers: solitaireplus/career/rewards.py.

tasks.prompt: Fix B24 (roulette re-spin never pays): roulette.py start_spin doesn't reset payout_claimed (only adding a new bet type does), and settle_roulette_round returns early when payout_claimed is set, so a second spin with the same bets pays nothing (no XP, no achievements). Reset payout_claimed (and round_complete / result) in start_spin. Also fix tests/test_career_ratings.py around the roulette test, which hid this by resetting the flag by hand: remove that manual reset so the test exercises the real path. Test: two spins with the same bets both pay.

Fix B25 (roulette cash taken when the spin doesn't start): the Spin handler deducts the stake before checking that start_spin() returned True. Deduct only when the spin really starts (or refund). Test: a refused spin (e.g. already spinning or no bets) leaves career/sandbox cash unchanged.

Fix B26 (roulette shows the old result against a new stake): adding chips after a round (roulette.py bet placement) keeps the previous result and round_complete, so the old result is shown next to the new stake. Clear result and round_complete when bets change after a round. Test: after a finished round, placing a new chip clears the shown result.

Fix B27 (blackjack duplicate cards): blackjack.py draw_card rebuilds a full 52-card deck mid-hand when the deck runs out; the game object lives for the whole run, so a round can show the same card twice. Before dealing a round, reshuffle a fresh deck if fewer than ~15 cards remain; never rebuild mid-hand; if the deck still runs out mid-hand (guard), build it from cards not currently in play. Test: deal 200 rounds (seeded) and assert no round ever shows a duplicate card across all hands on the table.

Fix B28 (wrong blackjack 3:2 rounding): blackjack.py pays a natural with int(round(self.bet * 2.5)), which uses banker's rounding. Check the money type first (whole dollars?). With whole-dollar chips pay bet + (bet * 3 + 1) // 2 (half-up); if the game supports cents, keep the exact amount. Test: bets 1, 3 and 5 return 1+2, 3+5 and 5+8 (half-up on 1.5, 4.5 and 7.5).

Fix B29 (a single-hand bust is recorded as 'split'): blackjack.py routes an unsplit bust through _resolve_split_round. Unsplit rounds must use the unsplit resolution. Test: after a single-hand bust, result == 'dealer' (and split-round bookkeeping untouched).

Fix B30 ('low stand' achievement without standing): solitaireplus/profile/achievements.py relies on a 'stood' flag that is True on every round-ending path. Pass a real 'player chose Stand' flag from blackjack (set only when the player pressed Stand) and use it for the achievement. Test: doubling down to 11 does not award the low-stand achievement; standing on a low total does.

Fix B31 (horse-race music ducking becomes permanent): start_horse_race_music captures the 'previous' music volume even when the music is already ducked, and stop_horse_race_music restores that ducked value; Options then saves it. Capture the base volume only when not already ducked, and restore it on every exit path from the horse races (leaving the screen by any route, debug menu, end night). Test: enter and leave the races twice; the music volume is back to the original value.

Fix B33 (Faro risk-free rating): faro.py's remove and clear don't lower wagered_total, and the session code uses wagered_total > 0 to mean 'really played', so a player can place, remove, deal and cash out to get a rating change without risking money. Track the money actually at risk when a turn resolves (e.g. count stakes only when a deal settles them) and use that for 'really played'. Test: place a bet, remove it, deal, cash out: no rating change; a settled bet still counts.

Fix B34 (blackjack fonts every frame): _render_blackjack_fit builds up to 9 pygame SysFont objects per label per frame. Use the shared font cache solitaireplus.ui.text.get_font (ui_text.get_font) so each font is built once; output pixels must not change. Test: drawing the blackjack screen twice builds each font once (count pygame.font.SysFont/Font calls), and the rendered surfaces are byte-identical before/after.

Fix B66 (roulette chip labels truncate '$1,500' to '1k'): roulette_ui.py abbreviates chip/stake amounts so 1500 shows as 1k. Show one decimal where needed: 1.5k (and keep whole thousands as 1k, 2k ...). Test: the label function gives '1.5k' for 1500, '1k' for 1000, '2.5k' for 2500, and unchanged labels below 1000.
